projects.name: Repo Organization
projects.description: Two-repo split (ventus-ai-backend, ventus-ai-frontend), clean backend tree, staging/prod sync on code and migrations (not data), and GitHub-driven deploys. Prerequisite for safe STAR pilot and team clarity.

issues.title: Define two-repo split scope (backend vs frontend)
issues.description:
Document ventus-ai-backend vs ventus-ai-frontend boundaries.

**Backend:** functions/, shared/, monitors/, sql/migrations/, scripts/, config/, infra/, docs/ (OpenAPI + webhook guide), RUNBOOK, deploy workflows.

**Frontend:** Vite/Lovable marketing, future portal (Next.js), supabase/ prototype only — NOT the production pipeline.

See docs/internal/repo-organization-north-star.md.

issues.title: Repo hygiene: untrack .env and add .env.example
issues.description: Remove tracked .env from git. Add .env.example (API keys, staging base URL placeholders). Rotate any secrets that were ever committed in .env.

issues.title: Reorganize sql into sql/migrations with numbered files
issues.description: Move existing SQL scripts into sql/migrations/001_*.sql format. Add sql/migrations/README.md: apply in numeric order; staging schema first, then public.

issues.title: Implement DB_SCHEMA in shared/db.mjs
issues.description: Support DB_SCHEMA env (staging vs public). Set PostgreSQL search_path on connect. Wire all Lambdas through createDbFactory.

issues.title: Add config/environments staging.json and production.json
issues.description: Non-secret environment manifest: apiBaseUrl, dbSchema, ventusEnvironment, s3IngestPrefix, lambdaNamePrefix, queue suffix. Deploy workflows read these — no console-only drift.

issues.title: Create Aurora staging schema and schema_migrations table
issues.description: CREATE SCHEMA staging. Add schema_migrations(version) per schema. Run all migration files against staging before any staging Lambda traffic.

issues.title: Deploy ventus-staging-* Lambdas and S3 staging/ ingest
issues.description: Staging copies of api, ingest, classify, pillar, lifestyle, risk, travel. S3 uploads under staging/ prefix route to staging ingest only. Env vars from config/environments/staging.json.

issues.title: Verify staging isolation with test CSV upload
issues.description: Upload test file to staging/ prefix. Confirm pipeline_runs and transactions exist only in staging schema, not public. Document evidence in RUNBOOK.

issues.title: GitHub workflow deploy-staging.yml
issues.description: On merge to main: npm test, check:routes, package:functions, package:monitors, OIDC deploy to ventus-staging-* Lambdas, apply staging migrations, qa:live, smoke staging API.

issues.title: GitHub workflow deploy-prod.yml with same SHA gate
issues.description: GitHub production environment + required reviewers. Deploy the same commit SHA that passed staging. Apply migrations on public schema. smoke prod API.

issues.title: RUNBOOK: canonical deploy via GitHub not laptop
issues.description: deploy.sh is break-glass only. Document promotion: staging deploy → smoke → prod deploy (same SHA). Migration order staging then public.

issues.title: Rename openapi-draft to docs/openapi.yaml
issues.description: Move docs/openapi-draft.yaml to docs/openapi.yaml. Update check:routes, Postman generator, partner guide links. CI fails if API routes drift from OpenAPI.

issues.title: Host live /docs from OpenAPI
issues.description: Partner-discoverable API reference at api.ventusai.com/docs (Redoc/Swagger) or docs subdomain. Regenerate/bundle on deploy.

issues.title: Move internal docs to docs/internal/
issues.description: Relocate enterprise audit, OIDC guide, QA harness, tech readiness backlog under docs/internal/. Keep docs/ root partner-facing.

issues.title: Write ventus-ai-backend root README
issues.description: Prod and staging API URLs, partner doc links, npm test/package commands, pointer to RUNBOOK and repo-organization north star.

issues.title: RUNBOOK Releases section (staging to prod)
issues.description: Document same git SHA on staging and prod Lambdas, migration order, and monitor repackage step when shared/batch-stuck.mjs or shared/webhooks.mjs change.

issues.title: Unify monitor packaging with main Lambda package pipeline
issues.description: DONE: package-monitors.mjs now copies full backend/shared/ (excluding *.test.mjs), same rule as package-functions.mjs. Redeploy ventus-stuck-job-monitor after pulling this change if shared/ was updated recently.

issues.title: CI check: repackage monitors when shared webhook modules change
issues.description: Optional follow-up: PR path filter or deploy-staging workflow always runs package:monitors when shared/ changes. Manual rule until then: shared/* change → npm run package:monitors → update monitor Lambdas.

issues.title: Create GitHub repo ventus-ai-backend and migrate code
issues.description: Extract backend/, infra/, partner docs from monorepo. Update GitHub OIDC trust policy repo path to VentusCard/ventus-ai-backend. CI green on new repo.

issues.title: Create GitHub repo ventus-ai-frontend and migrate code
issues.description: Extract src/, public/, vite config, supabase/, amplify.yml. Reconnect Lovable project to new repo URL. Portal app folder when started.

issues.title: Archive ventus-ai monorepo with README redirect
issues.description: Mark monorepo archived or read-only. README links to ventus-ai-backend and ventus-ai-frontend.

issues.title: Frontend README: Supabase is not production
issues.description: Banner in frontend repo: production enrichment is AWS Lambdas at api.ventusai.com. supabase/functions is prototype/demo only.

issues.title: CODEOWNERS for infra vs functions vs docs
issues.description: Optional GitHub CODEOWNERS: /infra/, /functions/, /docs/ for review routing on large backend repo.
